text:
maria: backup-bot flagged multiple restore failures: "decrypt failed: missing key metadata". looks like CMK header absent on some archived DB snapshots.
backup-bot: ALERT 1765555560 - 5 restores failed (uploader v2.1.0).
leo: quick triage: a recent multipart uploader fork in canary strips headers prefixed with 'x-encrypt-' during compose. our CMK id was stored in x-encrypt-cmk.
aj: scope? customer vs internal?
leo: ~380 objects across 2026-03-19..21, mostly multipart >5GB. tenant-mix includes paying customers.
samir: no KMS decrypt logs for these objects; restores abort before KMS is called because metadata missing.
maria: immediate mitigation ideas?
nancy: do not auto-fallback to tenant-default CMK (policy/legal risk). enable manual restore path where ops supplies CMK after tenant verification; require audit entry.
leo: engineering fix: revert uploader fork to upstream v2.0.7 which preserves headers. canary in ~1h, prod after smoke. opening PR now.
samir: repair options: safest = reupload from original archive; alternative = metadata-replace via compose (GCS only, fragile). estimate ~4.5TB total; can do bucket-to-bucket over 24-48h.
eng-oncall-bot: incident created INC-2026-511 assigned to leo (P2).
maria: action items: 1) leo revert PR + canary deploy 2) manifest of affected objects (leo) 3) migration ticket + customer impact (leo) 4) ops manual-restore runbook and comms (samir/nancy).
aj: forensics: snapshot current object state before any repairs.
leo: manifest pushed to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/INC-2026-511/manifest.csv
maria: no auto-repair until pilot reupload verifies KMS logs. add CI test for multipart metadata preservation.
leo: will add tests and CI gating to PR. updates posted here as we roll canary.
eng-oncall-bot: canary deployed 1765556868; basic smoke passed.
maria: thanks team. keep comms tight and log every manual restore in encryptops channel. :lock:
